1: * { box-sizing: border-box; }

9: h2 { margin: 0 0 16px; font-size: 22px; }

11: .eyebrow { color: #53636e; font-size: 14px; }
12: .panel { background: #fff; border: 1px solid #d8e0e5; border-radius: 12px; padding: 28px; }
13: .product-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 24px; }
14: .product-art { position: relative; background: #dce6e9; border-radius: 12px; min-height: 310px; }
15: .headband { position: absolute; width: 180px; height: 175px; border: 18px solid #304550; border-bottom: 0; border-radius: 100px 100px 0 0; left: 31%; top: 48px; }
16: .ear-left, .ear-right { position: absolute; width: 54px; height: 100px; background: #304550; border: 8px solid #58717e; border-radius: 22px; top: 158px; }
17: .ear-left { left: 28%; }
18: .ear-right { left: 59%; }
19: .product-info { display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; }
20: .price { font-size: 28px; font-weight: 700; margin: 16px 0; }
21: .options-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 24px; }
22: .context { color: #53636e; margin-bottom: 20px; }
23: .choice { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 12px; margin: 0 0 18px; padding: 12px; border: 1px solid #d8e0e5; border-radius: 8px; }
24: .choice input { width: 20px; height: 20px; margin: 3px 0 0; flex-shrink: 0; }
25: .choice .detail { display: block; color: #53636e; font-size: 14px; }
26: .muted { color: #53636e; }
